meta.title: Rox Capital Partners — Investing in growth, partnering for the long term
meta.description: Rox Capital Partners is a Texas-based private equity firm, founded in 2017, partnering with founders, families and management teams in distribution, manufacturing, industrial and healthcare businesses.

lede: Rox Capital Partners is a Texas-based private equity firm with offices in Austin and Dallas. We partner with founders, families and management teams to build industry-leading businesses.

thesis.text: Founded in 2017 by Al Cameron and Mark Sparrow, Rox takes a hands-on, roll up your sleeves approach that goes beyond capital, to support and scale small and medium-sized businesses.

stats.k: Founded, with offices in Austin and Dallas

steps.title: Best-in-class management.
steps.text: We partner with seasoned management teams, and frequently with founders, to invest in high-performing, market-leading businesses, with a flexible approach to structure.

steps.title: Operational strength.
steps.text: Our team's operational backgrounds give hands-on experience that turns into practical, results-driven support, including effective financial controls and processes.

steps.title: Commercial excellence.
steps.text: We work alongside leadership on commercial excellence and corporate strategy, growing through organic initiatives and strategic acquisitions to create long-term value.

focusIntro: We invest in and scale businesses that underpin the efficient functioning of society: essential, often undercapitalized sectors with durable demand and modernization potential.
sectorsText: Industries with durable demand, where operational improvement and strategic growth can drive outsized returns.
pillars: We take our role as stewards of our investors' capital seriously, with a disciplined, focused approach in every decision we make.
By drawing on a wide range of perspectives and lived experiences, we create the conditions for innovation, growth and meaningful employment across our portfolio.
We are committed to reinvesting in the communities around us, fostering environments where people and businesses can thrive.
portfolioIntro: Industrial, water infrastructure and consumer services businesses across Texas and beyond.

portfolio.name: Interstate Threaded Products
portfolio.desc: Manufacturer of specialty threaded fasteners, anchor bolts and custom-engineered fastening solutions for infrastructure, power generation, petrochemical, telecommunications and construction markets. Founded in 1973. The launch of Rox's industrial fastener platform.

portfolio.name: Haven Hub
portfolio.desc: Residential home services platform for turf, pavers, concrete, retaining walls and pergolas, with digital 3D renderings on site during consultations. A growth equity investment.

portfolio.name: Alpha General
portfolio.desc: Founded in 1978, Alpha General manufactures fiberglass tanks, basins and accessories for the water and wastewater industries, for municipal and contractor markets.

portfolio.name: Scruggs Company
portfolio.desc: Supplier of valves and valve controllers to the water and wastewater industries, founded in 1912. Combined with NTS, MAV and Schuermann into a municipal water infrastructure platform, sold to The Sterling Group in 2026.

portfolio.name: Neil Technical Services
portfolio.desc: The leading provider of service to the water and wastewater industry in the Houston area, with 24/7 service. Merged with Scruggs Company in 2023.

portfolio.name: Mid-America Valve & Equipment
portfolio.desc: Supplier of valves and valve controllers for the water and wastewater industries in Kansas and Western Missouri, founded in 2003. Acquired by Scruggs and NTS in 2025.

portfolio.name: Schuermann
portfolio.desc: Founded in 2002, Schuermann Enterprises and Schuermann Analytics provide specialized products, services and data-driven solutions to the water and wastewater industry.

portfolio.name: Amifast
portfolio.desc: Fasteners and hardware for the construction and precast concrete industries, with global sourcing and manufacturing. Sold to Afinitas in 2021.

portfolio.name: Car-X
portfolio.desc: Rox Capital participated in the acquisition of four Car-X locations in the San Antonio market.

portfolio.name: Foundation Auto Repair
portfolio.desc: Full-service automotive repair, founded in 2005, with two locations in the Austin area.

portfolio.name: Reliable Automotive
portfolio.desc: Three-location auto repair business that expanded rapidly to become the market leader in its area.

teamIntro: Expertise across every major business function, working with management to find opportunities, solve challenges and drive lasting improvements.
